audit.why: Poppy through 4-5, Skill at 6 and first item, Poppy again at 2+ items matches the packet chart row for row and matches the whys. 50% win rate over 456 games supports a lane that swings on his ultimate rather than one side owning it.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[] has only three entries and none of them is his level-6 spike, even though Purgatory is what the whole page says rewrites the lane.
audit.why: The packet flags 'spikes[] has 3 entries, expected 4'. The missing one is the enemy's biggest window, so the chart of power spikes reads as if the lane never changes hands.
audit.corrected: Created spikes[3] with Purgatory's 1000-range execute at level 6 — the fourth spike the structure has always been missing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three separate factual problems. (1) The page calls him 'a 125-range mana champ' twice — Soul Nails is a 950-range projectile and Ashen Pursuit reaches 425; nothing in his kit is 125 range. (2) whys[0] and spikes[0] credit Steadfast Presence with winning Level 1, but Poppy has exactly one ability at level 1 and W is not one of them. (3) The Q is called 'Ritual Nails' throughout; the ability text reads 'Locke readies a set of Soul Nails to throw'.
audit.why: A player told to step up on a 125-range laner will walk into a 950-range poke tool, and one told their W wins level 1 will look for a button they do not have.
audit.corrected: Range corrected to 950 with the 70 mana cost; the W claim moved to Level 2 where W actually exists, keyed to Ashen Pursuit being his only exit on a flat 10s; the ability called Soul Nails.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8] says 'Anti-heal is optional — his sustain is self-refund, not lifesteal.'
audit.why: Soul Ignition heals back a portion of the damage he takes during the effect. Grievous Wounds reduces healing regardless of where the healing comes from, so anti-heal is not optional in an extended trade.
audit.corrected: Item line now calls for Grievous Wounds against Soul Ignition, and corrects 'his damage is AP' to magic damage, which is what his passive actually deals.

edits.after: Purgatory executes from 1000 range and he gains power for every champion he seals — his real spike, and the reason to end fights above the floor.

edits.before: Level 1 your Q poke and W's dash-denial win the trade — his mobility game is dead on arrival.
edits.after: Level 1 is one ability each: his Soul Nails chip from 950 range, but he cannot close on you — farm and deny.

edits.before: Level 2 your poke and anti-mobility keep the edge yours — he cannot start his pattern without a dash.
edits.after: Level 2 W comes online and Ashen Pursuit is his only exit — a dash you stop leaves him slowed and grounded.

edits.before: W dash-denial breaks his mobility pattern
edits.after: W stops Ashen Pursuit, his only escape dash

edits.before: Level 1 he’s a 125-range mana champ throwing nails — step off the recast lines and take what the range difference offers.
edits.after: Level 1 he throws Soul Nails from 950 range at 70 mana a cast — sidestep them, tax the mana, and farm until you have E.

edits.before: Levels 1-3: he pays for every CS at 125 range — tax him, but step off the Q recast lines; the mark stacks are the only currency he trades in.
edits.after: Levels 1-3: he farms with 950-range Soul Nails at 70 mana a throw — sidestep them, tax the mana, and punish the 10s after each Ashen Pursuit.

edits.before: Early HP and MR blunt the nail chip (his damage is AP). A stopwatch/Zhonya’s-class answer beats Purgatory outright: untargetable at the floor = execute denied. Anti-heal is optional — his sustain is self-refund, not lifesteal.
edits.after: Early HP and MR blunt the nail chip — his passive is magic damage on-hit. A Zhonya’s-class answer beats Purgatory outright: untargetable at the floor = execute denied. Bring Grievous Wounds: Soul Ignition refunds part of the damage he takes.

notes: Ability-name flag rather than a silent fix elsewhere: the page calls his Q 'Ritual Nails' in eight places (winCon, enemyWin, focus.text, loading, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0], report[3], report[5]). His ability text says 'Locke readies a set of Soul Nails to throw', and the _missing rows name the other four abilities (Silver Stake, Soul Ignition, Ashen Pursuit, Purgatory) but never Q, so I could not confirm the canonical Q name — I used Soul Nails only in strings I was already correcting for the range error and left the eight 'Ritual Nails' strings untouched rather than propagate a guess. That needs one decision from the user and then a find-and-replace. Also unfixable here: spikes[0].when says 'Lvl 1' and should read 'Lvl 2' now that the W claim is correctly placed, but it is 5 characters and the applier skips anything under 25.
